newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne German logistics unit wins contracts.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne German logistics unit wins contracts.

text.p: Kuehne & Nagel(AG & Co) said its new Germany logistics subsidiary launches its first two projects for major clients.

The global freight forwarder's Germany division said Kuehne & Nagel Eurologistik GmbH had gained logistics contracts from Lufthansa catering subsidiary LSG Catering Logistik and household goods and pharmaceutical goods company Reckitt & Colman.
KN Eurologistik has established a central warehouse in Dietzenbach, near Frankfurt, for LSG, a company statement said.
This organises distribution of more than 500 types of catering articles from 12,000 pallet positions to all Lufthansa stations worldwide, the statement said.
KN Eurologistik also developed a central warehouse in Mannheim for Reckitt & Colman, the statement said.
The forwarder handles 25,000 tonnes a year in the 6,000 sq. metres facility and organises a 24 to 48 hours delivery service. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
